sql:
SELECT AVG(e.cost) AS average_cost
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name = 'Elijah Allen'
AND strftime('%m', e.expense_date) IN ('09', '10')
